title: Change Record
description: One record per merged change to claude-code-shared, written passively by scripts/attribution/write-change-records.py into attribution/change-records/<change_id>.json after the merge. Keyed by merged_sha. See change-record-contract.md.

change_id.description: Stable id derived from merged_sha: 'chg-' plus its first 12 hex characters. Also the record's file name stem.

lane.description: How the change entered main. seed and learnings are the automated lanes; manual is a PR the user merged by hand.

source_refs.description: Pointers back to where the change came from, e.g. 'pr:109', 'branch:feat/app-groups'. Seed and learnings lanes also carry their Learning-Ids in source_refs.

target_repo.description: Org/Repo the change was merged into, taken from the origin remote when available.

touched_paths.description: Repo-relative paths under claude-code-shared/ that the merge changed, sorted.

sections.description: Markdown sections the merge's diff hunks fall under, sorted by path then section.

section.description: The full heading line, e.g. '## Instrument'. '(preamble)' for lines before the first heading.

touched_units.description: Units derived from paths, e.g. 'skill:debug', 'agent:build-runner', 'script:learning/log-learning.py'. Sorted, unique.

kind.description: Primary kind of the change. When a merge touches several kinds the first of skill, agent, contract, hook, script wins. config is reserved: config-only merges get no record.

base_sha.description: First parent of the merge commit: main as it stood before the merge.

merged_sha.description: The merge commit on main. The idempotency key.

merged_at.description: Committer date of the merge commit, ISO 8601 with offset.

ci_snapshot.description: Optional, informational, manual-lane records only. The CI per-test-file base-vs-head snapshot from the Test snapshot workflow's test-snapshot artifact for the merged PR's head sha. null when no artifact was available, gh failed or the machine was offline. Absent on seed and learnings lane records.

run_id.description: Workflow run the artifact came from.

head_sha.description: PR head sha the run was looked up by.

base.description: base.json from the artifact: run-all-tests JSON for the PR base ({results, totals}).

head.description: head.json from the artifact: run-all-tests JSON for the PR head.

diff.description: diff.json from the artifact (ci-snapshot-diff.py output); null when the artifact lacked it or it failed validation.
